Metadata.title: Persona — API documentation
Metadata.description: Explore Persona, the public API for coherent fictional people.

Home.eyebrow: Synthetic people for a brighter product world
Home.title: Generate coherent fictional people for products and tests.
Home.description: Persona returns a name, age, nationality, location, contact details, and a realistic portrait when available — reproducible with a seed.
Home.note: Start generating realistic personas in seconds. No API key required.
Home.sliderError: Live profiles are temporarily unavailable. Please reload this page.
Home.keylessDescription: Get started instantly. Open and free for everyone.
Home.seedDescription: Reproducible personas for reliable testing and consistent experiences.
Home.coverageDescription: {available} support profile generation; {pending} await name review.
Home.portraitsDescription: Reviewed portraits available across {contexts} portrait types.

Playground.title: Try /people
Playground.description: Generate realistic people with a simple API request. Configure the parameters below and see a live result.
Playground.aside:
Realistic data.
For a more open
and creative internet.
Playground.configurationHint: Set the parameters for your request. All fields are optional.
Playground.countHint: Preview 1 to 100 people. For larger collections, use API pagination.
Playground.ageLastSelected: Keep at least one age group.
Playground.residenceHintPending: This country is under name-pool review. Choose a nationality or continent as well to use it as a residence.
Playground.cityHintSelected: Search cities in the selected country

PortraitTypes.label: Portrait types
PortraitTypes.hint: Uncheck the portrait types to exclude.
PortraitTypes.empty: No type selected: profiles will be generated without portraits.

Playground.seedHint: Optional. Same seed and date produce repeatable results
Playground.resultCount: {count, plural, one {# person generated} other {# people generated}}
Playground.runToSeeResults: Run the request to see a live profile.
Playground.errorOfflineGuidance: Reconnect to the internet, then try the request again.
Playground.errorUnavailableGuidance: Wait a moment and retry the request.
Playground.errorServiceTitle: The Persona service hit an error
Playground.errorServiceGuidance: Wait a moment and retry the request.
Playground.errorEndpointTitle: The API endpoint was not found
Playground.errorEndpointGuidance: Check the configured API address, then retry.
Playground.errorInvalidResponseTitle: The API returned an unexpected response
Playground.errorInvalidResponseGuidance: Retry the request. If this keeps happening, inspect the response with the API team.
Playground.errorInvalidQueryTitle: The API rejected a query parameter
Playground.errorInvalidQueryGuidance: Review the parameter values and remove duplicates.
Playground.errorConflictGuidance: Adjust the filters so the country, continent, city, age and portrait choices can be used together.
Playground.errorUnsupportedTitle: The API does not support one of these values
Playground.errorUnsupportedGuidance: Choose a country, city or option available in the API.
Playground.errorTimeoutGuidance: Check your connection and try again.
Playground.errorGenericTitle: The request could not be completed
Playground.errorGenericGuidance: Try again. If it keeps failing, inspect the response JSON for technical details.
Playground.errorParamGender: Choose a supported gender or leave it set to Any.
Playground.errorParamAgeGroup: Choose one or more supported age groups.
Playground.errorParamContinent: Choose one of the five supported continents.
Playground.errorParamNationality: Choose a nationality available in the selected continent.
Playground.errorParamResidenceCountry: Choose a country with resident profile data.
Playground.errorParamCity: Choose a city in the selected residence country.
Playground.errorParamEmailDomain: Enter an ASCII domain with at least two labels and a valid alphabetic ending.
Playground.errorParamSeed: Use a nonblank seed of at most 128 characters, or leave it empty.
Playground.errorParamAsOf: Enter a real calendar date from 0102-01-01 through 9999-12-31.
Playground.errorParamFields: Choose supported response fields and remove duplicates.
Playground.errorParamPortraitContexts: Choose supported portrait types and remove duplicates.
Playground.errorParamSkinTone: Choose tones from 1 to 10, or All.
Playground.errorParamQuery: Shorten the request URL and remove repeated parameters.
Playground.problemAgeGroup: Select an age group that overlaps the selected portrait types.
Playground.problemResidenceNationality: This residence country has no reviewed name pool. Choose a nationality or continent before sending the request.
Playground.problemCity: Select a nationality or residence country before entering a city.
Playground.problemNationality: The nationality is outside the selected continent.
Playground.problemUrl: The request URL is too long. Select fewer fields.

Coverage.title: Data coverage by country

Coverage.errorDescription: Something went wrong while loading the country data.
